svg.title: Monthly local extent evidence: EACC candidate region,2013
svg.desc: Four panels show distinct scalar quantities, with separate lower/upper sampling brackets for5/10km steps and explicit unresolved markers. All72 cases and864 outcomes are in the JSON alternative. These are model-local diagnostics at15m, not admitted physical whole-current widths or climatological annual ranges.
svg.title: EACC candidate-region local extent evidence

ns2:Work.dc:title: EACC candidate-region local extent evidence
ns2:Work.dc:description: Primary monthly model-section sampling brackets at15m in2013; separate quantities and5/10km sampling. Every unsupported attempt remains explicit. No physical whole-current width or annual range admitted.

g.text: Local extents in the EACC candidate region · 2013
15 m · daily 00Z sampled monthly mean fields · primary latitude · 50% threshold
Model diagnostics: whole-current widths, physical annual ranges and uncertainty remain unadmitted.
Vertical bars show stored lower/upper bounds; no midpoint, connecting curve or annual envelope is calculated.
Missing/rejected attempts appear below the month axis, not as zero extents. Bounds are not confidence intervals.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #164e80

a.text: Source: HYCOM 2013 saved profiles · case 40128227569/1 · exact values and all 864 outcomes in the linked JSON bundle.
